Rashi on Sotah 10a:10:1.hebrew: מעין דוגמא כו' - נשתנו מן התחתונים לתפארת:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:10:1.english: After the likeness, etc. - They were distinguished from the lower beings, for glory.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:11:1.hebrew: ויסר כחו - לא מייתי ראיה אלא דכולן לקו:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:11:1.english: And his strength departed from him - He brings a proof only that all of them were afflicted.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:12:1.hebrew: שאול בצוארו - "ויגבה מכל העם משכמו" (שמואל א י׳:כ״ג):
Rashi on Sotah 10a:12:1.english: Saul, in his neck - "And he was taller than any of the people from his shoulders [and upward]" (I Samuel 10:23).

Rashi on Sotah 10a:12:2.hebrew: ויפל עליה - מקום שהורגין בחרב, והיינו צואר:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:12:2.english: And he fell upon it - The place where they kill with a sword, and that is the neck.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:13:1.hebrew: צדקיה בעיניו - לא ידענא מנלן דנשתנה לשבח, וכן אסא ברגליו, אלא כן שמע מרבו:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:13:1.english: Zedekiah, in his eyes - I do not know from where we derive that he was changed for praise [i.e., that his punishment was fitting for something praiseworthy], and likewise [that] Asa [was punished] in his feet; rather, so he heard from his teacher.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:14:1.hebrew: פודגרא - (צינית (שיגרון או שיגדון ברגליים)) שם חולי הוא שאוחז ברגלים, וקורא לו "פודגרא":
Rashi on Sotah 10a:14:1.english: Podagra - (Cold (rheumatism or gout in the feet)) It is the name of an illness that seizes the feet, and he calls it "podagra."

Rashi on Sotah 10a:15:2.english: Angaria - The king's service [i.e., forced labor or corvée imposed by the king]:

Rashi on Sotah 10a:15:3.hebrew: השמיע את כל יהודה - הזעיקן, וישאו את אבני הרמה שהיה מלך ישראל בונה עליה כרך, לבלתי תת יוצא ובא לאסא:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:15:3.english: He proclaimed to all of Judah - He summoned them, and they carried off the stones of Ramah, upon which the king of Israel was building a fortress, so as not to allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:15:4.english: A bridegroom - Concerning whom it is written, "he shall be free for his house," etc. (Deuteronomy 24:5).

Rashi on Sotah 10a:16:1.hebrew: כתיב וירד שמשון תמנתה - אלמא תמנת בירידה. וכתיב "עולה תמנתה" - אלמא עלייה היא. ושמשון ויהודה תרוייהו בארץ ישראל הוו:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:16:1.english: It is written: "And Samson went down to Timnah" - Evidently, Timnah is [reached by] descent. And it is written, "is going up to Timnah" - Evidently, it is [reached by] ascent. But Samson and Judah were both in the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:16:2.hebrew: שנתגנה בה - שנשא מבנות פלשתים, האסורות לו:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:16:2.english: That he was disgraced through it - For he married [a woman] from the daughters of the Philistines, who were forbidden to him.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:16:3.hebrew: יהודה נתעלה - שמשם נולדו פרץ וזרח, שהעמידו מלכים ונביאים בישראל:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:16:3.english: Yehudah was elevated - For from there [from Yehudah] were born Peretz and Zerach, who produced kings and prophets in Israel.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:18:1.hebrew: דאתי מהאי גיסא - שהיתה מיושבת באמצע שיפוע ההר: הבא לה מראש ההר — יורד, הבא לה מרגלי ההר — עולה:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:18:1.english: That one comes from this side - For it was situated in the middle of the slope of the mountain: one who comes to it from the top of the mountain goes down, [and] one who comes to it from the foot of the mountain goes up.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:18:2.hebrew: כגון ורדני ובי בארי ונרש - עיירות הן, היושבות בשיפוע ההרים:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:18:2.english: For example, Vardani, Bei Bari, and Naresh - These are towns that are situated on the slopes of the mountains.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:19:1.hebrew: מצפות לראותו - שהיו רגילין להתקבל שם וללון, והיה חביב עליהם:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:19:1.english: Looking out to see him - For they were accustomed to be received there and to lodge [there], and he was dear to them.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:1:1.hebrew: הוחל שבועתו של אבימלך - בטלה. לשון "לא יחל דברו" (במדבר ל), לפי שהם עברו על השבועה תחילה:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:1:1.english: The oath of Avimelekh was profaned - It was nullified. The expression is from "he shall not profane his word" (Numbers 30); [it was nullified] because they were the first to transgress the oath.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:1.hebrew: שנתנה עינים לדבריה - דוגמא ופתח היתר נתנה לעצמה, שאין עבירה בדבר:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:1.english: That she gave eyes to her words - She gave herself an example and an opening of permissibility, [showing] that there is no transgression in the matter.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:2.hebrew: גיורת אני - ואיני עובדת כוכבים, וראויה לך:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:2.english: I am a convert - And I am not an idolater, and I am fit for you.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:3.english: I am unattached - and permitted to any man.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:4.hebrew: יתומה אני - והייתי קטנה, והשיאוני אמי ואחיי. ואין נישואין לער ואונן כלום, לאסור עליו משום כלתו, ואין זכות לאם ולאחים להשיא קטנה, אלא האב זוכה בה, כדכתיב: את בתי נתתי לאיש הזה (דברים כ״ב:ט״ז). ולהך סברא לאו בתו של שם היתה, שמשנת ששים ליעקב כלו שנותיו של שם, ויעקב כבר היה יותר מבן מאה ועשר:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:4.english: I am an orphan - I was a minor, and my mother and my brothers married me off. The marriage to Er and Onan is therefore worth nothing, [so that it would not] prohibit her to [Judah] on account of her being his daughter-in-law; for a mother and brothers have no authority to marry off a minor — only the father has authority over her, as it is written: "I gave my daughter to this man" (Deuteronomy 22:16). And according to this reasoning, she was not the daughter of Shem, for in Jacob's sixtieth year Shem's years came to an end, and Jacob was already more than one hundred and ten years old.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:20:5.english: I am pure - From [the impurity of] a menstruating woman.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:21:1.english: And he planted in it - To give benefit to passersby.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:22:1.hebrew: פונדק - ללון שם אורחים. ולשון אש"ל נוטריקון הוא: אכילה, שתיה, לויה — שהיה מאכילן ומשקן, ואח"כ מלווה אותן:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:22:1.english: Inn - For guests to lodge there. And the word *eshel* is an acronym: *achilah* (eating), *shetiyah* (drinking), *levayah* (escort) — for he would feed them and give them drink, and afterward accompany them.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:22:2.hebrew: ויטע אהלי אפדנו - פסוק הוא בדניאל על אחד מהמלכים:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:22:2.english: And he shall plant the tents of his palace - It is a verse in Daniel, [speaking] about one of the kings.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:1.hebrew: במה בירכו - כל ברכה שבמקרא לשון ריבוי הוא, דבר המרבה ומצוי בו שובע, פוייש"ן (פוישו"ן: שפע) בלע"ז. ומה ברכה נמצא בו? לא מצינו עושר בשמשון:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:1.english: With what did He bless him? - Every [instance of] blessing in Scripture is an expression of increase: something that increases and has abundance in it — poyshon (poyshon: abundance) in the vernacular (Old French). And what blessing was found in him? We do not find wealth in Samson.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:2.hebrew: שברכו באמתו - להיות זרעו כנחל שוטף. למה שנתאוה, נתברך:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:2.english: That He blessed him with his truth - That his offspring should be like a flowing stream. [He was blessed] with that which he desired.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:3:1.hebrew: נקם אחת משתי עיני - שכר אחת מעיני תן לי בנקמה זו, ושכר האחרת לעולם הבא:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:3:1.english: Avenge [me] one [vengeance] for my two eyes - Give me the reward for one of my eyes through this vengeance, and the reward for the other in the World to Come.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:4:1.hebrew: שחוזר לאחוריו - כשצדין אותו, אינו (מרחיק) לברוח, אלא חוזר עקלקלות:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:4:1.english: That it turns back - When they hunt it, it does not run far away to flee, but rather turns back along winding paths.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:5:1.english: On his shoulders - According to the measure of his shoulders.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:5:2.english: The gate of the city - The verse is speaking of Gaza.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:1.hebrew: קמי דשתי חמרא חמרא - לפני כל אדם מביאין מה שהוא רגיל בו: לפני שותי יין — מביאין יין:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:1.english: Before one who drinks wine, [bring] wine - Before every person, they bring what he is accustomed to; before those who drink wine, they bring wine.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:2.hebrew: קמי רפוקא גרידיא דובלא - לפני עובד אדמה וחופר בגנות, שרגיל לאכול ירק, מביאין סל מלא ירק. דובלי מין ירק הוא:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:2.english: Before a digger, a scraper, a basket - Before a tiller of the soil who digs in gardens and is accustomed to eating vegetables, they bring a basket full of vegetables. "Dubli" is a type of vegetable.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:7:1.hebrew: קארי ובוציני - מין אחד הוא, אלא שאלו גדולים ואלו קטנים. כלומר, במה שהוא עוסק — היא עסוקה:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:7:1.english: Kari and butzini - They are one species, except that these are large and those are small. That is to say, in whatever he is engaged, she is engaged.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:1.english: As one - Like the Unique One of the world, in just judgment.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:2.hebrew: שמש - לשון חומה, כמו "ושמתי כדכוד שמשותיך" (ישעיהו נ״ד:י״ב):
Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:2.english: Shemesh - An expression for a wall, as in "And I will make your battlements [shimshotayich] of rubies" (Isaiah 54:12).

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:3.hebrew: על שמו של הקב"ה - משמע שכינהו בשמו של הקב"ה ממש:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:3.english: By the name of the Holy One, Blessed be He - This implies that he called him [Samson] by the actual name of the Holy One, Blessed be He.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:4.english: Corresponding to his name - For "shemesh" [sun] here does not mean literally the sun, but rather a shield and protector.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:9:1.hebrew: שפי - אשלויישי"ש, כמו "דשף מדוכתיה" (חולין דף מב:):
Rashi on Sotah 10a:9:1.english: Shefi - [Old French] *eslaïssié* ("dislocated"), like "he was dislocated [*dashaf*] from his place" (Chullin 42b).

Tosafot on Sotah 10a:8:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה לא ימחה - תימה לרבי: מאי שנא משלום? דאמר בפ"ק דשבת (דף י:): אמר רב המנונא משמיה דעולא: אסור לאדם שיתן שלום לחבירו בבית המרחץ, משום דשם גופיה איקרי שלום, כדכתיב: "ויקרא לו ה' שלום". ולא קא חשיב ליה במס' סופרים (פ"ד) בהדי שמות שאין נמחקין! ונראה דתנא ושייר. ועדיף מחנון ורחום, דאמר בפרק שבועת העדות (שבועות דף לה.) דנמחק, דלא אשכחן שקרא הקב"ה שמו כך חנון. והכא פריך אהא דקאמר "על שמו של הקב"ה נקרא", משמע דשמו נקרא כך, והיינו דקא דחי: אלא מעין שמו, כמו חנון, על שם שהוא חונן ומרחם על בריותיו:
Tosafot on Sotah 10a:8:1.english: But if so, it should not be erased - It is astonishing to the Rabbi: How is this different from "Shalom"? For it says in the first chapter of Shabbat (10b): Rav Hamnuna said in the name of Ulla: It is forbidden for a person to greet his fellow with "Shalom" in a bathhouse, because [God's] name itself is called "Shalom," as it is written: "And he called Him 'Hashem-Shalom'" (Judges 6:24). Yet [the Tanna] does not count it in Tractate Soferim (chapter 4) among the names that are not erased! And it appears that the Tanna taught [some] and omitted [others]. And [Shalom] is stronger than "Chanun" and "Rachum," which it says in the chapter Shevuat HaEdut (Shevuot 35a) may be erased, since we do not find that the Holy One, blessed be He, called His name "Chanun" in this way. And here [the Gemara] objects to what it said, "it is called by the name of the Holy One, blessed be He," which implies that His name is called thus; and that is why it rejects [this]: Rather, [it is] "in the likeness of His name," like "Chanun," because He is gracious and merciful to His creatures.
